title: NeuroLearn AI
summary: An intelligent, multi-provider AI learning platform featuring curriculum generation, diagnostic self-checks, concept-level reteaching, and multi-source research coordination.
problem: Generic AI learning tools deliver superficial one-shot summaries with high hallucination risk and lack structured pedagogical reteaching loops or student privacy controls.
solution: Architected an open-source Next.js 15 + React 19 pedagogical learning system with multi-provider inference (Nebius Token Factory, NVIDIA Nemotron, Google Gemini, Groq), autonomous multi-source academic research coordination, and local-first guest persistence.
contribution: Engineered the universal Research-to-Teaching coordinator with SSRF-safe multi-source querying (Wikipedia, OpenAlex, Crossref, OpenStax, Tavily), deterministic multiple-choice grading, diagnostic roadmaps, and WCAG AA accessible UI with Hindi and Telugu multi-lingual support.
features: Engineered multi-source research retrieval pipeline integrating Wikipedia, OpenAlex, Crossref, and OpenStax with strict prompt-injection and SSRF filtering.
Integrated flexible AI providers including Nebius Token Factory, NVIDIA Nemotron, Gemini API, and Groq with transparent fallback labels.
Built resilient local-first browser storage and opt-in PostgreSQL repository with row-level security and zero learner data tracking.
Validated with 10 canonical benchmark evaluation topics across STEM, Humanities, and Financial Literacy.
verifiedResult: Full test suite passing (typecheck, lint, unit tests, and 10 canonical benchmark evaluation topics)

title: Amazon ML Challenge 2026 — Entity Resolution
summary: A high-throughput, memory-bounded machine learning pipeline resolving merchant identity across millions of noisy commercial records without pretrained embedding models.
problem: Matching identical business entities across heterogeneous data sources with noisy names, partial addresses, and severe class imbalance at scale (1.7M+ test anchors).
solution: Built a scalable candidate generation inverted index and 19-feature LightGBM classification pipeline with hard-negative mining, calibrated thresholding, and streaming validation.
contribution: Developed custom inverted index with token-frequency weighting, 19 rapid pairwise similarity features (RapidFuzz Normalized Indel, token overlap, numeric conflicts), and zero-leakage partition streaming.
features: Engineered multi-token inverted index processing 207M+ candidate links across 1.73M anchors with 0.9118 holdout candidate recall.
Extracted 19 pairwise similarity and interaction features with memory-mapped Arrow stores and deterministic tie-breaking.
Trained hard-negative LightGBM achieving 0.8879 Macro F0.5 (0.9563 Precision, 0.8053 Recall) on local 5,000-anchor calibration holdout.
Validated end-to-end pipeline with 39 automated tests and streaming compliance checks.
verifiedResult: 0.8879 Local Holdout Macro F0.5 (0.9563 Precision) across 39 verified unit and streaming tests

title: Credit Card Approval Prediction (CreditGuard AI)
summary: An end-to-end Machine Learning solution evaluating credit applicant delinquency risk with explainable AI and automated CI/CD testing.
problem: Financial institutions face high credit default rates due to inaccurate risk profiling and imbalanced applicant data.
solution: Developed a machine learning classification engine using XGBoost and SMOTE oversampling to accurately detect high-risk applicants.
contribution: Built custom data preprocessing pipelines, SMOTE oversampling, interactive Flask dashboard, and automated GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows.
features: Designed custom preprocessing pipelines & SMOTE-oversampling, achieving 66.67% delinquency recall on imbalanced credit data.
Built interactive prediction and metrics dashboards using Flask and Bootstrap 5 with Dark/Light modes.
Configured automated MLOps CI/CD via GitHub Actions for testing, lints, Docker builds, and deployment.
verifiedResult: 66.67% Delinquency Recall with automated CI/CD test suite

title: FarmaLink-AI
summary: A Next.js 15 + React 19 agricultural SaaS platform connecting farmers directly with buyers, logistics networks, and cold storages.
problem: Agricultural supply chains suffer from intermediary price exploitation, lack of crop disease diagnostics, and opaque transaction escrow.
solution: Engineered a platform featuring AI disease diagnostics, crop yield/price prediction, and simulated escrow transaction wallets.
contribution: Architected Next.js 15 App Router pages, Prisma + Supabase schema definitions, Zustand store state management, and production CI/CD check guards.
features: Designed AI-powered disease diagnostics, price prediction simulations, and real-time escrow wallet transactions.
Stabilized production CI/CD check pipelines, ESM migrations, and Next.js App Router middleware guards.
